vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2468: OKF knowledge skill v1 — Karpathy-loop wiki + okf-embeddings vector extension (/okf)

plan.title: OKF knowledge skill v1 — Karpathy-loop wiki + okf-embeddings vector extension (/okf)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Project knowledge lives only in heads and transcripts; agents re-derive context every session — slowly, expensively, sometimes wrongly. There is no maintained, searchable, conformant knowledge bundle per project, and no pipeline loop that keeps one current.
narratives.Proposal: Ship one portable Claude Code skill (/okf, sources at skills/okf/ in this repo) that maintains a per-project OKF v0.1 bundle in a PR-gated peer-directory knowledge repo, with Karpathy-style study/retro/sync/lint loops, a deterministic Python conformance gate, and the okf-embeddings v0.1 extension (committed manifest + committed per-profile vector shards + gitignored SQLite FTS5/sqlite-vec index, hybrid BM25+vector RRF with BM25-only degradation, keyless Ollama default). Track B integrates Overdeck: a first-class `knowledge` agent role (pan knowledge <id>, live TUI, Command Deck visible), mnemos + Ollama on-demand installers, mega-brain-style session-start concept injection inside the existing prompt-time injection path, and opt-in post-merge auto-retro. Execute PRD work items WI-1..WI-22 exactly as specified in .pan/drafts/pan-2468.md; each work item is one bead.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Graph visualizer, lease-based writes, and an own MCP server (stay deferred in PAN-2066; mnemos covers MCP read meanwhile)
- Section-level chunking and multimodal embeddings (okf-embeddings v0.2)
- Dashboard knowledge-health surface (concept count, staleness, conformance status) — separate follow-up issue after v1
- kcmd / Google Knowledge Catalog cloud sync (compatibility posture only, PRD §5.6)
- PAN-1641's Pi-harness agent execution via Ollama — separate issue; this plan only builds the shared install substrate (src/lib/ollama.ts)
- WI-23 upstream okf-embeddings proposal — post-v1, after ≥2 real bundles run it
- No new PipelineIssuePhase for knowledge agents — they render as agents under the issue, not as a pipeline stage
- The knowledge role never enters the code-repo review/merge pipeline, never runs pan done
- Silent model substitution — unservable --model is a hard error (D-8), never a warn-and-continue
- No vectors in frontmatter, ever (single optional x_embed: exclude key only)

autoDecisions.summary: Adopted all twelve PRD decisions D-1..D-12 verbatim (name /okf + pan knowledge, skill home skills/okf/, committed default-profile shards, extension-standard posture, deterministic gate, whole-concept chunking, kcmd compatibility-only, hard-error on unservable --model, mega-brain replicated in-injection-path, mnemos on-demand never hard dependency, keyless Ollama default profile, knowledge role model mirrors plan's ref).
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD §5.7 explicitly states these are 'made here, not re-litigated later'; auto mode honors documented decisions instead of re-asking.

autoDecisions.summary: Bead granularity = one bead per PRD work item WI-1..WI-22 (22 beads); WI-23 excluded as post-v1.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD's work items are already tracer-bullet slices with named tests and verified file anchors; finer splitting would break the commit-per-work-item contract in PRD §6, and WI-23 is explicitly gated on ≥2 real bundles existing.

autoDecisions.summary: requiresInspection: true only on okf-common-parser (foundation for validate/reindex/embed/search) and knowledge-role-registration (foundation for CLI verb, Command Deck, auto-retro); all other beads false.
autoDecisions.rationale: These two beads' interfaces (parser/hash contract, Role union + spawn semantics) are what downstream beads encode assumptions about; everything else is pinned exactly by the PRD spec text or surfaces defects at typecheck/lint/test.

autoDecisions.summary: Track A beads verify via bash skills/okf/scripts/selftest.sh (grown incrementally from WI-1); Track B beads verify via targeted vitest + npm run typecheck/lint.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD §5.2 makes selftest.sh the end-to-end harness including negative tests; Track B acceptance criterion 12 names the standard quality gates.

WI-2: okf_common.py shared parser + normalized-content hashing

expected_outputs: selftest fixture round-trip passes; hash stable across timestamp-only edits; code-fenced links ignored

narrative.Action: Implement skills/okf/scripts/okf_common.py — the ONE shared parser used by validate/diff_lint/reindex/embed/search: PyYAML frontmatter parsing, code-fence-aware relative-link extraction, concept-ID resolution (path minus .md), and normalized-content SHA-256 hashing per PRD §5.3 (frontmatter minus timestamp, plus body, LF-normalized, trailing whitespace stripped). Plain CPython stdlib + PyYAML only (NFR-6). This is the foundation every other script imports — its function signatures and hash rule are load-bearing.

WI-3: validate.py two-tier gate + diff_lint.py

expected_outputs: missing-type fixture exits 2; diff-lint tolerates pre-existing warnings and fails newly introduced breakage

narrative.Action: Implement validate.py (deterministic two-tier gate: ERROR codes = unparseable frontmatter, missing/empty type, reserved-file misuse; LINT codes = missing description, broken links, stale index; exit 0 clean / 1 lint-only / 2 errors; --strict promotes lint to failure) and diff_lint.py (was-clean-now-broken: compares validation between PR base and head so pre-existing warnings never block but new breakage does). Codes documented in references/conformance.md. No LLM anywhere in the gate (NFR-1). Identical code runs locally and in CI.

WI-4: /okf init — peer-directory knowledge repo scaffold

expected_outputs: selftest scaffolds to a temp dir; validate exits 0; conformance.yml parses as YAML; .okf.yml points at the peer path; manifest default profile is ollama

narrative.Action: Implement the init command: default target is a peer directory (code repo ~/Projects/<name> → ~/Projects/<name>-knowledge, new git repo + gh repo create), with --dir <path> and --local <subdir> overrides. Init writes templates/repo/* (README, CONTRIBUTING, CODEOWNERS, .github/workflows/conformance.yml running validate.py --strict + diff_lint.py, index.md, log.md, .gitignore covering .okf-index/ and unshared shards), seeds starter concepts (Overview + first Decision), writes the default keyless Ollama okf-embeddings.yaml manifest (PRD §5.3 exact content), writes the pointer file .okf.yml at the code-repo root (bundle + remote keys, PRD §5.1), and appends one discovery line to the code repo's CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md. Resolution order for later commands: projects.yaml knowledge_repo: → .okf.yml → error with init instructions.

items.title: Given a temp code repo named acme, running init with no flags creates ../acme-knowledge as a peer directory whose bundle passes validate.py --strict with exit 0
The generated .github/workflows/conformance.yml parses as valid YAML and contains invocations of validate.py --strict and diff_lint.py
The generated okf-embeddings.yaml contains default_profile pointing at an ollama/nomic-embed-text/768 profile with share: true, and the generated .gitignore contains .okf-index/
The written .okf.yml records bundle: ../acme-knowledge and the created remote; --local <subdir> instead produces an in-repo bundle and no companion repo
Given a code repo, init writes exactly one discovery line to CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md and a second init run preserves it without duplication

WI-9: /okf retro — post-implementation knowledge capture

narrative.Action: Implement retro: review the change (diff + available session context) and answer "what would have made this work easier if documented?", filing answers as concepts via PR. Two feedstock paths: with Overdeck detected, mine the issue's Observations via `pan memory search --issue <id>`; standalone, use git diff + the current transcript. WI-10: embed.py + okf-embeddings manifest/shard implementation

expected_outputs: fake-provider test: one edited concept re-embeds exactly one shard line; shard round-trips; non-localhost ollama refused

narrative.Action: Implement embed.py driven by okf-embeddings.yaml exactly per PRD §5.3: four provider adapters (ollama default with a localhost-only endpoint guard, openai, voyage, custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint + env-var key) behind the contract embed(texts) -> list of L2-normalized vectors, batched. Hash-gated incremental embedding (unchanged concept never re-embedded, NFR-4), sorted-by-id JSONL shard writer replacing lines in place (6-decimal precision, one line per chunk: id, concept, hash, dim, v), x_embed: exclude honored, whole-concept chunking with max_tokens truncation (D-6). Plain CPython + PyYAML (NFR-6). No hardcoded model fallback: an unconfigured profile errors loudly.

items.title: Given a fake provider and one edited concept among many, embed rewrites exactly one shard line and all other lines remain byte-identical

WI-11: build_index.py + search.py — hybrid BM25+vector RRF

expected_outputs: BM25-only ranking with no vector backend; hybrid changes ranking; token budget respected; mnemos path exercised when binary present, skipped cleanly when absent

narrative.Action: Implement build_index.py (markdown + shards → gitignored .okf-index/okf.db: SQLite FTS5 for BM25 plus sqlite-vec when importable, BLOB-cosine fallback otherwise; rebuildable from markdown+shards via --rebuild and from markdown alone by re-embedding, NFR-5) and search.py (hybrid RRF with K=60 merging BM25 and vector lists; degradation ladder hybrid → BM25-only → index-guided reading per NFR-2; --format prompt|json; --budget <tokens>). When mnemos is on PATH with the bundle ingested, search MAY delegate to `mnemos search` as the retrieval backend, mapping its file#section citations to concept IDs; the built-in path remains the guaranteed floor. Deleting .okf-index/ and searching transparently rebuilds it.
